summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P 500 High Dividend Growers ETF (DIVG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 High Dividend Growth index. The fund tracks a yield-weighted index of 100 companies in the S&P 500 with the highest forecasted dividend yield growth. DIVG was launched on Dec 6, 2023 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: DIVG is an equity ETF with a total of 101 individual holdings. The top holdings are HP Inc. stock at 3.11%, Franklin Templeton at 2.25%, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company at 2.21%, Altria Group at 2.19%, and Prudential Financial at 2.10%.
